detail.title: 4-in-2 USB-A/PD Input Charging Cable
detail.overview: Discover the 4-in-2 USB-A/PD Input Charging Cable by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: Universal 4-in-2 cable for fast charging with multiple connectors.
Includes 8 Pin, USB-C, Micro USB, and magnetic connectors.
Supports 20W PD fast charging for efficient power delivery.
1.8/6ft length offers flexibility for various charging setups.
Compatible with smartphones, smartwatches, and other devices.
